paragraphs.text: Serenok was the abbot of Keral Keep on the plane of Regatha .

Serenok and Mother Luti took it upon themselves to personally mentor Chandra Nalaar after her arrival on Regatha to secure a powerful heir to the role of abbot of Keral Keep . Although Chandra had little formal training, her potential was vast, and her pure powers were growing rapidly. This was especially apparent after Chandra, out of all those present, managed to defeat an attacking hellion during a flamewaking ritual.

Serenok was old, and though his powers were still unmatched by most, he could feel his heart's fire burning out. The time to pass his mantle to Chandra was now, but she was unwilling to take on the mantle as his formal heir, for reasons both known and unknown to herself. It wasn't until Serenok passed away in his sleep that Chandra suddenly understood the pressure she was under, and the need for Keral Keep to appoint a successor abbot immediately.
